tasks.title: Map OO word SDK asc_* API surface to a WO wasm export spec (KEYSTONE)
tasks.description: The keystone of the OO→Rust 1:1 port: enumerate the OnlyOffice word SDK's JavaScript-callable API surface — the native-engine boundary the web-apps UI drives — and map each method to a required wo-renderer-wasm export (existing or missing). This is the port CONTRACT. VERIFIED FACTS (do not re-derive): the extracted unique asc_* method names (970) are at /tmp/oo-asc-api.txt on this host (read-only). SOURCES (read-only): (1) unminified word SDK bundle: docker cp oo-rig:/var/www/onlyoffice/documentserver/sdkjs/word/sdk-all.js /tmp/sdk-word.js — 852249 lines; (2) OO web-apps UI controllers: /tmp/oo-src/documenteditor/main/app/controller/ (Toolbar.js 4415 lines, Main.js 3533, DocumentHolderExt.js 3086, LeftMenu.js 1061, etc.); (3) this worktree's wo-renderer-wasm crate at server/core/crates/wo-renderer-wasm/src/lib.rs (35 wasm_bindgen exports). DELIVERABLE (commit under plan/oo-port/): (1) plan/oo-port/wasm-api.json — an ARRAY of objects, one per unique asc_* method (all 970), each {name, group, side, ui_caller_count, wo_export_name, wo_missing}. group is a coarse semantic area from: document, paragraph, run-format, selection, view, zoom, scroll, table, list, section, header-footer, comment, field, bookmark, search, print, download, undo-redo, content-control, chart, image, shape, equation, smartart, review, proofing, collab, protection, other. side: engine-query | engine-mutation | discovery | data-class-ctor | object-op. (2) plan/oo-port/wasm-api.md — report: totals per group; the 35 existing wo-renderer-wasm exports (extract by grepping the crate for pub fn after #[wasm_bindgen]) and which asc_* each covers; TOP 50 missing methods ranked by ui_caller_count; refactor recommendations (which WO exports to rename to match asc_* 1:1). METHOD: docker cp the SDK once; use /usr/bin/node to extract method usage frequencies from the SDK and the controllers; classify asc_get*=engine-query, asc_put*/asc_set*=engine-mutation, asc_C*=data-class-ctor. Script the JSON generation then curate groups via a lookup table. CONSTRAINT: wo_export_name filled for every row the existing WO export list covers; every other row wo_missing=true. Do not edit any Rust/JS source — two artifact files only.
tasks.acceptance: plan/oo-port/wasm-api.json parses, is an array of >= 900 objects all carrying the 8 fields, group distribution spans >= 15 distinct values, and the md report exists, is >= 150 lines, mentions a top-50 missing list and names >= 20 of the 35 existing WO exports.
tasks.accept: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && /usr/bin/node -e 'const a=require("./plan/oo-port/wasm-api.json"); if(!Array.isArray(a))process.exit(1); const req=["name","group","side","ui_caller_count","wo_export_name","wo_missing"]; if(a.length<900)process.exit(2); if(a.some(o=>req.some(k=>!(k in o))))process.exit(3); const g=new Set(a.map(o=>o.group)); if(g.size<15)process.exit(4); console.log("ok",a.length,g.size)' && test "$(wc -l < plan/oo-port/wasm-api.md)" -ge 150 && grep -qiE 'top-?50|missing' plan/oo-port/wasm-api.md && test "$(grep -coE 'asc_[A-Za-z0-9_]+' plan/oo-port/wasm-api.md)" -ge 50
